# `agenda_item_proceedings`

Qualified, provenance-bearing links from durable RIN agenda items to independently identified Proceedings. Rows exist only when a docket, regulations.gov document, or Federal Register artifact directly reports the RIN; Unified Agenda equality cannot manufacture a link.

- **Parquet file:** `materialized/ontology/latest.json` (atomic snapshot manifest)
- **Supported by MCP `query_sql` after first publication:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `relationship_id` | `VARCHAR` | Stable opaque relationship id. Primary key. |
| `agenda_item_id` | `VARCHAR` | Canonical agenda-item IRI; joins to `regulatory_agenda_items.agenda_item_id`. |
| `rin` | `VARCHAR` | Denormalized RIN for convenient filtering. |
| `proceeding_id` | `VARCHAR` | Independently assembled action; joins to `proceedings.proceeding_id`. |
| `relationship_role` | `VARCHAR` | Fixed local role `agenda_tracks_proceeding`, mapped to Rulespec `rkaf:agendaTracksProceeding`. |
| `source` | `VARCHAR` | `docket_rin`, `document_rin`, or `federal_register_rin`. |
| `evidence_id` | `VARCHAR` | Source docket id, regulations.gov document id, or FR document number supporting the relationship. |
| `evidence_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Permanent source URL for the evidence artifact or registry record. |
| `evidence_date` | `VARCHAR` | Best available source date for the relationship evidence. |
| `method` | `VARCHAR` | Derivation method; `deterministic`. |
| `actor_id` | `VARCHAR` | Versioned relationship-assembly ruleset. |
| `run_id` | `VARCHAR` | Pipeline run identifier. |
| `asserted_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC assertion timestamp. |
| `supersedes_id` | `VARCHAR` | Prior assertion revised by this row, when applicable. |
